package.name: pinkrab_interfaces
package.description:
Service and message definitions shared by the Pinkrab nodes. Torque, emergency stop and the teleop mode are each one call, so a client cannot leave the robot half-configured between a parameter set and a trigger. Joint data stays on sensor_msgs/JointState and is not redefined here.
Nothing but rosidl and builtin_interfaces is depended on, so a node that only needs to speak to the driver does not pull in the driver.
